subject: Error while using DArT data for recombination analysis

messages.author: d89993b905b0ab8c
messages.subject: Error while using DArT data for recombination analysis
parts:
Hi, 

I want to use Poppr for analysis of DArT (dominant markers)data for haploid fungal pathogens to study frequency and diversity of pathogen in the field. This is how my data look like and it is stored in CSV format. The total number of individuals are 200 and markers are 6000 and above. 

 content of filename.csv

Marker00001 Marker00002 Marker00003
1 1 1 1
2 1 01
3 01 1
4 1 1 NA

I converted the CSV file into genind and genind2pop using adegenet package
R script: 
file <- read.csv(file="filename.csv", head=TRUE, sep=",")
obj <- df2genind(file, ploidy=1, type="PA")
obj2 <- genind2genpop(obj)
package(poppr)
data("obj2")
   Warning message:
    In data("obj2") : data set ‘obj2’ not found

I tried to use it as data("obj2") as well as for "obj" variable in poppr with and without "" but doesn't seem to work. 

I am pretty sure, I am not doing it right but couldn't figure out what is happening. If someone can help me with this, I would be very grateful.  

Many Thanks.

messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: Re: [poppr] Error while using DArT data for recombination analysis
parts:
> file <- read.csv(file="filename.csv", head=TRUE, sep=",")
> obj <- df2genind(file, ploidy=1, type="PA")
> obj2 <- genind2genpop(obj)
> package(poppr)
Everything above seems correct except for "package(poppr)". What you want is "library(poppr)".

> data("obj2")
> Warning message:
> In data("obj2") : data set ‘obj2’ not found
>
> I tried to use it as data("obj2") as well as for "obj" variable in poppr with and without "" but doesn't seem to work.

You don't need to use "data()". If you type "obj" or "obj2" in your R console (without quotes), you'll find a genind/genpop object printed to your screen.

The "data()" function is meant to load pre-existing dataset within a package.

I hope that helps,

Zhian
